# mm-mcp

> MCP server for Mattermost that acts as you: read and search, and post only when you allow it, confirming every write. No plugin or admin needed.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/vriesdemichael/mm-mcp): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://vriesdemichael.github.io/mm-mcp/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
